📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick track and thumb colors.
  2. Set the scrollbar width and corner radius.
  3. Optionally enable a thumb hover color.
  4. Scroll the live demo, then copy the CSS.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does it work in all browsers?
WebKit/Blink browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari) use the ::-webkit-scrollbar rules; Firefox uses the scrollbar-color / scrollbar-width fallback included in the snippet.
Will it style my whole page's scrollbar?
The snippet only styles scrollbars inside the element you apply the class to — your page's default scrollbar is untouched.
How do I get a minimal thin scrollbar?
Set the width low and the radius high, then pick matching thumb/track colors — the live demo updates as you drag.
